title: Fully faithful restriction to K-flat representatives
statement: Let C be a category essentially small in the coefficient universe, J a topology with the module-sheafification assumptions, and R a commutative ring sheaf. Let A be its category of module sheaves with an existing derived category. For any target category D, restriction along the inclusion of independent-coefficient K-flat cochain complexes followed by the actual derived localization Q is fully faithful on functor categories, with independent object and Hom universes. The definitions and hypotheses are as in [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tags 06YS, 07A4 and 0G7E; exact proof previously private in IntegralComparisonSequenceSystems.

proof.text:
every homotopy object has a K-flat resolution, giving the hypotheses of
resolvingRepresentativesFullyFaithfulWhiskering on the K-flat full subcategory.
Transport its product restriction comparison by quotientCompQhIso. Apply the
projection/diagonal construction unaryWhiskeringOfProduct to obtain unary full
faithfulness for the actual derived localization on cochain complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem kflatWhiskering
    {D : Type e} [Category.{f} D]
    {C : Type a} [Category.{b} C] [EssentiallySmall.{c} C]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{c} RingCat.{c})]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{c}]
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{c}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{c})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{d} (SheafOfModules.{c}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{c} RingCat.{c})).obj R))] :
    let A := SheafOfModules.{c}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{c} RingCat.{c})).obj R)
    let P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex A ℤ) :=
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R)
    Nonempty (((whiskeringLeft P.FullSubcategory (DerivedCategory A) D).obj
      (P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)).FullyFaithful)
